levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Marks steps complete without physically re-checking, missing an obviously undone step.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Correctly identifies which of the four steps were done versus undone through a physical re-check.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Correctly identifies all four and explains why the specific undone step tends to get skipped.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Identifies an undone step but does not fix it.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Fixes every undone step found during the check.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Fixes every undone step and names a specific change that would prevent it from recurring, such as moving the trash bag closer next time.

lookFors: The reflection describes a specific before-and-after state, not a vague "I fixed it."
The transfer prediction in the independent task names a specific step, not "I'll try to remember everything."

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
